claim: If the game can leave its logic without passing the hook that ends the speed window, the next latch reads the build's own 28 MHz as the game's clock for good; keep a flag saying whose clock it is.

evidence.text: After game over the latch read the build's own 28 MHz as the game's clock: interrupts 35 a second, AY writes doubled, updates 60% short; only a soak with a seed reaching game over showed it.
